beats.narration_text: Three terms. Hemisphere: An orientation-based ambient approximation. Wrap lighting: An artistic broadening of the lit region. Packed map: A texture holding multiple independent controls.

terms.meaning: An artistic broadening of the lit region
A texture holding multiple independent controls

beats.narration_text: This combined shader first decodes its normal map. The green flip defaults to true because the demo supplies the DirectX-style map. Reusing a different normal map requires checking that convention.

props.title: Trace The Model
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Red now masks the highlight, and blue masks the environment reflection. The earlier red-rim, green-highlight packing does not apply. A texture can load successfully while controlling the wrong contribution.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: specular_map.r

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: specular_map.r

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: specular_map.r

props.title: Recheck Packed Channels
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Ambient blends from bottom color toward top color using the upward normal component clamped at zero. Downward and horizontal normals receive bottom color. This is not a symmetric full-sphere interpolation.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 ambient =

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 ambient =

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 ambient =

props.title: Ambient By Orientation
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Subsurface spread modifies the light-normal dot product before clamping. Subsurface color adds a channel-dependent bias. These are artistic controls that soften and tint the transition around the terminator.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 lambert =

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 lambert =

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 lambert =

props.title: Broaden The Light
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Watch spread increase from zero toward one half. More of the surface receives a positive lighting contribution. No thickness, internal scattering path, or transmitted-light calculation appears in the shader.

show.event: Act: Test The Model. Watch The Terminator

beats.narration_text: The environment contribution has its own contrast, intensity, and blue-channel mask. Unlike the earlier rim-weighted cubemap shader, this reflection is not multiplied by that Fresnel term.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: reflection_intensity * specular_map.b

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: reflection_intensity * specular_map.b

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: reflection_intensity * specular_map.b

props.title: Keep Reflections Separate
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: The rim is multiplied by diffuse lighting and light color. The specular lobe uses its red mask. The environment is added separately. Naming each term makes an otherwise crowded expression understandable.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 total_spec

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 total_spec

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: vec3 total_spec

props.title: Read Every Addition
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: The textured base receives ambient plus direct light, then the extra contributions are added. It is a useful teaching combination, not a complete physical material. Its tangent-frame scaling limitation also remains.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: ALBEDO =

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: ALBEDO =

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: ALBEDO =

props.title: A Combined Model Has Limits
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Let’s recap with Claude. The normal-map convention is explicit. Packed channels differ from the earlier specular map. Ambient and diffuse use new approximations. The final color is a sum of identifiable contributions. Liam, in for Bear.

beats.narration_text: Audit the combined shader's normal-map convention and specular channels. Then vary subsurface spread. Explain the terminator change without describing it as simulated light transport through the material. Check two things: Red masks highlights and blue masks reflections. The green flip matches the supplied DirectX-style map.
